instruction: How to create a Consul ServiceSplitter on Kubernetes
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1
kind: ServiceSplitter
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  splits:
  - service: web-v1
    weight: 90
  - service: web-v2
    weight: 10'

instruction: How to create a Consul ServiceResolver on Kubernetes
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1
kind: ServiceResolver
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  redirect:
    service: web-v1
    datacenter: dc2'

How to backup Consul data on Kubernetes
output: kubectl exec consul-server-0 -n consul -- consul snapshot save /tmp/backup.snap && kubectl cp consul/consul-server-0:/tmp/backup.snap ./backup.snap

instruction: How to restore Consul data on Kubernetes
output: kubectl cp ./backup.snap consul/consul-server-0:/tmp/backup.snap && kubectl exec consul-server-0 -n consul -- consul snapshot restore /tmp/backup.snap
